meta.title: Award value comparator dataset
meta.cpp: (cash fare − award taxes − award fees) ÷ points × 100, in US cents
meta.notes: Chart programs: points = official median where published, else chart price. Dynamic programs: points = median of the lowest price per travel date (nonstop if seen on ≥3 dates, else one-stop). Every row carries its source.

aeroplan.name: Aeroplan
aeroplan.note: Chart with 'starting at' floors; Air Canada and select partners (United, Etihad) are priced dynamically above the floor, and the chart publishes the median members paid.

united.name: MileagePlus
united.note: No published chart; prices move with demand.

flyingblue.name: Flying Blue
flyingblue.note: Dynamic pricing with published 'from' levels; Light/Standard/Flex fares since 8 Sep 2026.

etihad.name: Etihad Guest
etihad.note: Fixed 'Value' prices per route on Etihad flights; distance chart on partners.
